reports.title: Increment requests — status report
reports.tatNote: TAT: calendar days from submission to the final decision, or to today while open (Asia/Dubai).
reports.increaseNote: Monthly increase: as approved for approved employees, as proposed while pending; none when rejected.
reports.truncated: Only the first {count} employees are included. Narrow the filters to see the rest.

notes.tat: TAT: elapsed days (24 hours each) from submission to the final decision, or to now while open.
notes.criterion: Criterion TAT: from when a criterion started waiting for Sirius HR (submission, or the employee's resubmission after a return) to its verification.
notes.backAndForth: Back-and-forth: time employees spent returned to the subsidiary, and the time from a Sirius HR question to the subsidiary's answer.

figures.averageReturn: Average days with the subsidiary per return
figures.averageAnswer: Average days to answer a question

groupData.fieldsNote: Template version {version}. Fill one row per employee in the first sheet, as at the end of the month. Keep the column names; add no formulas.

issues.unreadable: The file can't be read as Excel (.xlsx) or UTF-8 CSV.
issues.macros: The workbook contains macros. Save it as a plain .xlsx workbook.
issues.too_large: The workbook expands to more data than allowed.
issues.empty_file: The file has no employee rows.
issues.too_many_rows: The file has more rows than allowed.
issues.unknown_column: This column isn't in the template and was ignored.
issues.duplicate_column: This column appears more than once.
issues.formula: Formulas aren't accepted: paste values only.
issues.invalid_date: Not a date. Use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.
issues.invalid_number: Not a number. Use digits with up to 2 decimals.
issues.not_allowed: Not one of the allowed values.
issues.duplicate_employee: This employee ID appears more than once.
issues.invalid_currency: Not an ISO currency code (e.g. AED).
issues.left_without_date: An employee who left needs a leaving date.
issues.future_date: The date is after the end of the month.
issues.date_order: The dates are in the wrong order.
